zh.summary: 先讓測試抓到缺漏仍匯出的錯誤，再做最小修正，最後在相同行為下整理程式。
objectives: 區分預期需求失敗與環境失敗。
操作 Red、Green、Refactor 的小步循環。
保留每次命令及結果，不放寬測試迎合錯誤。

readingGuide.goal: 區分預期需求失敗與環境失敗。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 獨立 tdd-lab/、已安裝 pytest 8.4.2 的 Python；不修改工作坊參考解答。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份可重現 Red、Green、Refactor 的小型規則練習與真實執行紀錄。

sections.heading: 讓一項要求先成為可失敗的測試
paragraphs: 測試驅動開發（TDD）先把一項要求寫成測試，執行後確認它因缺少該行為而失敗，再寫足夠的程式讓它通過，最後整理內部結構。Red、Green、Refactor 是回饋循環，不是三份成果狀態貼紙。
本篇在獨立 tdd-lab/ 練習「文件類型缺漏不得產生完整報告」這一小條要求。它不是整份 reference 解答，尚未涵蓋另兩欄、長度、欄位白名單與介面。不要用此練習取代完整程式。

sections.heading: 像先用量具確認缺口，再修到合格
paragraphs: 量具要能分辨不合格與合格；若不合格材料也過關，就先修正量測方法。把測試跑紅的目的，是確認回饋確實連到你要保護的行為。
語法錯誤、找不到 pytest 或測試未被收集，都不是此處要觀察的缺漏匯出失敗。先看失敗訊息，再決定修程式、測試或環境。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜TDD 的小步回饋
blocks.description: 每次只推進目前要求，完成後再選下一個情境。

items.title: Red
items.body: 測試因缺少預期行為而失敗。

items.title: Green
items.body: 最小修改使相同測試通過。

items.title: Refactor
items.body: 維持行為，改善命名或結構後再測。

sections.heading: Red：先確認錯誤能被抓到
paragraphs: 在獨立目錄建立 export_gate.py，放入以下故意缺少驗證的起點；再建立 test_export_gate.py。這份起點是人工練習，不是目前公開 reference 的缺陷。
執行 python -m pytest -q，負向情境應因沒有拋出 ValueError 而失敗，正常資料案例通過。請保留輸出與原因，不能只把紅色畫面當作達成 TDD。

blocks.heading: export_gate.py｜練習起點
paragraphs: 只放在新建 tdd-lab/，不覆蓋原型 rules.py。

blocks.heading: test_export_gate.py｜固定驗收行為
paragraphs: 兩個檔案放在同一目錄，用已安裝 pytest 的 Python 執行。

sections.heading: Green：修正行為，維持原測試
paragraphs: 將 export_gate.py 改成以下版本，再執行同一命令。輸入不是字串或去除首尾空白後為空，就拒絕產生完整報告；有效文字先去除首尾空白。
不要刪掉負向測試或把預期改成一律完整。測試通過後仍只證明這幾組輸入，還需要下一篇補足三欄與邊界。

blocks.heading: export_gate.py｜最小修正
paragraphs: 保留原測試，觀察負向案例是否由失敗轉成通過。

sections.heading: Refactor：讓行為保持、結構更清楚
paragraphs: 以下把文件類型的正規化與錯誤處理抽成具名函式，外部 build_report 介面及結果保持原樣。這只是本練習的整理方式；若目前程式已清楚，也可以先不增加抽象層。
重跑相同測試，再增加缺鍵、首尾空白與原資料不變的案例，檢查這次整理是否意外改變行為。增加新的業務要求應另外開始下一輪，不藏在重構中。

blocks.heading: export_gate.py｜整理後版本
paragraphs: 每次只改一個小範圍，保留對外契約。

sections.heading: 留下三個階段的證據
paragraphs: 紀錄測試內容、Red 的預期失敗、Green 的相同測試通過，以及 Refactor 後的回歸結果。若 Agent 一次提供整包答案，仍要核對它是否真的執行過這些步驟，不能由最終程式倒推開發過程。
此處是單一規則的練習。整合回三欄原型前，依原 spec 與完整測試核對，不將局部成功寫成全系統或資安完成。

exercise.environment: 獨立 tdd-lab/、已安裝 pytest 8.4.2 的 Python；不修改工作坊參考解答。
steps: 依序建立起點與測試，執行 python -m pytest -q，保存缺少例外的失敗。
使用最小修正版本重跑相同測試，再使用整理版本重跑。
補測缺鍵、首尾空白及輸入未被修改，記錄每階段結果與範圍。
exercise.expected: 一份可重現 Red、Green、Refactor 的小型規則練習與真實執行紀錄。
exercise.check: Red 必須因需求行為失敗；重構不放寬測試或增加未確認要求。
exercise.cleanup: 保留三階段程式與結果，別把人工缺陷起點誤放入正常專案。

en.summary: First make tests detect export despite missing data, then make a minimal repair and refactor while preserving behavior.
objectives: Distinguish expected requirement failures from environment failures.
Run a small Red, Green, Refactor cycle.
Preserve commands and results without weakening tests to fit faults.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish expected requirement failures from environment failures.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A separate tdd-lab/ and Python with pytest 8.4.2 installed; preserve the workshop reference solution.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A reproducible small rule exercise with actual Red, Green and Refactor execution records.

sections.heading: Make One Requirement a Test That Can Fail
paragraphs: Test-driven development (TDD) expresses one requirement in a test, runs it to confirm failure from missing behavior, adds enough code to pass, then improves internal structure. Red, Green and Refactor form a feedback cycle, not three status stickers.

In separate tdd-lab/, practice one rule: missing document type must not produce a complete report. This is not the reference solution; it omits the other two fields, length, output allowlisting and interface. Do not replace the complete program with this exercise.

sections.heading: Use a Gauge to Find the Gap Before Repair
paragraphs: A gauge must distinguish acceptable from unacceptable material. If defective material passes, improve the measurement. Running a test red checks whether its feedback detects the behavior you intend to protect.
Syntax errors, missing pytest and uncollected tests are not the missing-data export failure sought here. Read the failure before choosing to repair code, tests or environment.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Small TDD Feedback Steps
blocks.description: Advance only the current requirement, then select another scenario.

items.title: Red
items.body: The test fails because expected behavior is absent.

items.title: Green
items.body: A minimal change makes the same test pass.

items.title: Refactor
items.body: Preserve behavior, improve naming/structure and test again.

sections.heading: Red: Confirm Detection of the Fault
paragraphs: Create export_gate.py in a separate directory with the deliberately unvalidated starting code, then create test_export_gate.py. This is an injected exercise, not a defect in the public reference.
Run python -m pytest -q. Negative cases should fail because no ValueError is raised, while valid data passes. Preserve output and reasons; a red screen alone does not establish useful TDD feedback.

blocks.heading: export_gate.py | Exercise Starting Point
paragraphs: Use only a new tdd-lab/; preserve the prototype’s rules.py.

blocks.heading: test_export_gate.py | Fix the Acceptance Behavior
paragraphs: Put both files in the same directory and run with Python containing pytest. The expected exception text means “missing document type”; the valid synthetic label and exact output are retained.

sections.heading: Green: Repair Behavior, Keep the Tests
paragraphs: Replace export_gate.py with this version and run the same command. Reject non-string values and text empty after trimming, and trim valid document text before output.
Keep negative tests and their expectations rather than accepting every input as complete. Passing covers these inputs only; the next lesson adds the three-field rules and boundaries.

blocks.heading: export_gate.py | Minimal Repair
paragraphs: Keep the original tests and observe negative cases changing from failure to pass.

sections.heading: Refactor: Keep Behavior and Clarify Structure
paragraphs: This version extracts document-type normalization and error handling into a named function, preserving build_report’s external interface and results. It is one way to organize this exercise; no extra abstraction is necessary if the existing code is already clear.

Rerun the same tests, then add missing-key, surrounding-whitespace and unchanged-input cases to check for unintended behavior changes. A new business requirement starts another cycle rather than hiding within refactoring.

blocks.heading: export_gate.py | Refactored Version
paragraphs: Change one small area at a time, preserving the external contract.

sections.heading: Retain Evidence from All Three Stages
paragraphs: Record test contents, expected Red failures, the same tests passing at Green and regression results after Refactor. If an Agent supplies a finished package, check whether these steps actually ran; final code cannot establish its development history.
This exercise covers one rule. Before integration with the three-field prototype, check original spec and full tests. Local success does not establish the whole system or completed security.

exercise.environment: A separate tdd-lab/ and Python with pytest 8.4.2 installed; preserve the workshop reference solution.
steps: Create the starting code and tests, run python -m pytest -q and preserve missing-exception failures.
Run the same tests with the minimal repair and then with the refactored version.
Add missing-key, trimming and unchanged-input tests; record each stage’s results and scope.
exercise.expected: A reproducible small rule exercise with actual Red, Green and Refactor execution records.
exercise.check: Red must fail on required behavior. Refactoring neither weakens tests nor adds unconfirmed requirements.
exercise.cleanup: Keep all three program stages and results; do not put the deliberately faulty starting code into the normal project.

zh.prompt: 哪種失敗最符合這次 Red 的目的？
options: 缺漏資料沒有拋出預期例外
rationales: 回饋確實抓到要求缺失。

en.prompt: Which failure fits the purpose of this Red stage?
options: The test file has a syntax error.
Missing data does not raise the expected exception.
rationales: The feedback detects the missing requirement.

zh.prompt: Green 階段應優先怎麼做？
options: 讓目前測試通過的最小修正
The smallest repair that passes the current tests.

zh.prompt: 哪個改動可歸入本篇重構？
options: 保留輸入輸出契約，抽出具名驗證函式

en.prompt: Which change is refactoring in this exercise?
options: Extract a named validation function while keeping the input/output contract.
